description: OpenAI API key. Used for chat completions, embeddings, audio, images, and the file API. The same key authenticates every endpoint under api.openai.com.

variants.description: Personal or workspace key issued at platform.openai.com. The `sk-proj-...` shape was introduced in 2024 for project-scoped keys; older user-scoped keys still match the unprefixed shape.

steps: Sign in with your OpenAI account (workspace SSO if applicable)
Pick a name + the project / workspace scope
Copy the value — it is shown once and never again
retrieval.notes: Project-scoped keys (`sk-proj-...`) inherit billing from the parent project and can be revoked independently. For server-to-server use, prefer them over user-scoped keys.

rotation.notes: Create the replacement key first and deploy it everywhere, THEN delete the old one from the same page. OpenAI imposes no overlap window — both keys stay live until you delete the old, so there is no race. Never edit a key in place; deletion is the only revocation.
